material_description: NASICON-type lithium hafnium phosphate with Li2O additive.
processing_method: Sintered at various temperatures (800-1100°C). | Solid-state reaction: Starting materials Li2CO3, HfO2, and (NH4)2HPO4 were mixed and reacted in a platinum crucible at 1173 K for 2h in air. The resulting material was wet ball-milled in methanol for 6h, reacted again at 1173 K for 2h in air, and reground. The powder (particle size < 1 µm) was mixed with 3 wt% PVA solution, pressed into pellets at 1 x 10^8 Pa, and sintered for 2h in air at temperatures up to 1593 K.
